_comment: Phase 2 (filled 2026-10-19 from phase2_template.json): seed-42 core arms. Template comment:
Phase 2 template: the Git-10M adapted arms against the frozen teacher and frozen FLUX. Two views per
FLUX arm (user decision 2026-10-14): (a) entries below = every arm at the FIXED aligned block k=28
(frozen included: its multi-block caches hold k=28, no extraction); (b) add 'flux-<arm>-best' entries
with per_dataset expect.k = the block eval.sweep select picks on THAT arm's own val split at 100 %
labels, exactly as phase1.json's frozen blocks (eurosat 38, brick-kiln 12, pv4ger 28, so2sat 28,
forestnet 56, bigearthnet 12) were picked on the frozen caches -- compare frozen-best vs adapted-best,
never adapted-at-frozen's-block. Timestep candidates (t100..t900, concat) and C are selected on val
per cell, identically for every FLUX arm. Adapted caches: experiments/isaac/git10m/extract_ckpt.sbatch
(CKPT=<run>/checkpoints/lora_last_*.pt, --array=0-5; multi-block, the frozen caches' 14 blocks); it prints
the entries; replace <NAME_fm>/<NAME_naive>/<NAME_proj> with the run-dir basenames
(git10m_flux_<hash>+<seed>+<arm>-<8hex>). A missing arm reports MISSING cells, never silently drops.
Fractions, seeds and the C grid are phase1's. Cells are keyed by model NAME under --out-dir: the
frozen k=28 entry is named flux-pretrained-k28 so it never overwrites phase1's flux-pretrained cells
(per-dataset blocks) in results/matrix; never reuse a phase-1 name with a different expect.
